{{Quote|A long time ago, in the earliest days of the Alliance, the Rebels aided in the evacuation of the rightful government of Velabri, the homeworld of my people. The officials and their families were smuggled out of the system just before the Imperial invasion fleet arrived.|[[Quillin Durand]]|<ref name="SF" />}}
In the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] conducted an '''invasion''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velabri]]. The Empire intended to exploit the native [[Velabri (species)|Velabri]] as a source of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] offered what limited assistance it could, smuggling out government officials and their families just prior to the arrival of the Imperial forces. During the evacuation, [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] saved a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying the family of [[Quillin Durand]]. In gratitude, Durand swore a [[Velabri Bloodvow]] to repay the debt to Cracken.<ref name="SF" />

Following the evacuation, the free Velabri joined the fledging Alliance, forming a strike force known as the [[Velabri Lancers]].<ref name="SF" />
